_readme: English contrast pairs for mean-difference (CAA) steering-direction extraction. Each pair shares a prefix and differs only in the target property. Positive and negative continuations are written to the same word count (the builder refuses a delta above one word) and the extractor additionally averages both sides over the same number of token positions, so neither the wording nor the read-out window can turn a style direction into a length direction. The five directions are the constraints whose violation is a local, continuous property of the text; the counting constraints (total words, sentence count, one name) are asked for in the prompt only, because there is no token-level direction that means 'stop at 60'.
